# Overview

This document will serve to validate the data that we produce for this
research project. Our analysis leverages the Aquatic Resource Trade In Species
(ARTIS) database, and therefore our validation checks will run checks on this
on the ARTIS data. For example, one validation check in ARTIS is to ensure
that their output consumption weights add back up to their production weights.
Here, our data leverages climate exposure obtained from SeaAroundUs (SAU), which
makes transformations to the consumption weights. We want to ensure that these
consumption weights, when modified by the climate exposure data, add back up
to the same volumes when looking between the production and consumption data
in the ARTIS consumption file. Additionally, we will confirm that the ARTIS
consumption file volumes add back up to the original production data used to
produce ARTIS consumption volumes.

The following sections will include the validation checks that we describe and
perform on this paper's data.

## Read in packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

## Run Validation checks

### Global prod weights modfied by exposure measure are identical to consumption

Here, we will read in ARTIS consumption data with a couple additional columns
used to modify the consumption volumes, notably `ssp126` and `ssp585`. These
are the climate exposure catch projections that we assign for each species and
taxa. We will ensure when the ssp126 and ssp585 measurements modify ARTIS
consumption, that their weights add back up to the production weights.

```{r validate prod-cons weights}
# Read in ARTIS consumption joined-to-exposure data
consumption_exp <- read_parquet("../output/consumption_catch_proj_gap_filled/3_species/consumption_total_portfolio_weighted_diagonal_gapfill.parquet") %>%
  filter(consumer_iso3c != "NEI")

# Check for NA rows in the ssp variables
## First for ssp126
n_na_cols_ssp126 <- consumption_exp %>%
  filter(is.na(ssp126)) %>%
  nrow()

# Print check
print(paste0(
    "Are there any NA rows in ARTIS data for ssp126? ",
    ifelse(n_na_cols_ssp126 == 0, "No", "Yes")
  ))

# Next check for ssp585
n_na_cols_ssp585 <- consumption_exp %>%
  filter(is.na(ssp585)) %>%
  nrow()

# Print check
print(paste0(
    "Are there any NA rows in ARTIS data for ssp126? ",
    ifelse(n_na_cols_ssp585 == 0, "No", "Yes")
  ))

# Check for both live weight tonnage and per capita consumption
for (var in c("live_weight_t", "consumption_percap_live_kg")) {

  # First confirm that there are no NA rows in ARTIS data
  n_na_cols_cons <- consumption_exp %>%
    filter(is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    nrow()

  print(paste0(
    "Are there any NA consumption rows in ARTIS data for ", var, "? ",
    ifelse(n_na_cols_cons == 0, "No", "Yes")
  ))

  # Dynamically define scenario column names
  ssp126_var <- paste0(var, "_ssp126")
  ssp585_var <- paste0(var, "_ssp585")

  # Modify consumption with the SSP columns
  consumption_exp_mod <- consumption_exp %>%
    mutate(
      !!ssp126_var := .data[[var]] * ssp126,
      !!ssp585_var := .data[[var]] * ssp585
    )

  consumption_exp_mod %>%
    filter(gapfill_level == "Unsuccessful gapfill")

  # Calculate global production totals
  prod_global_totals <- consumption_exp_mod %>%
    group_by(producer_iso3c) %>%
    summarize(
      !!ssp126_var := sum(.data[[ssp126_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      !!ssp585_var := sum(.data[[ssp585_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    summarize(
      !!ssp126_var := round(sum(.data[[ssp126_var]]), 0),
      !!ssp585_var := round(sum(.data[[ssp585_var]]), 0)
    )

  # Calculate global consumption totals
  cons_global_totals <- consumption_exp_mod %>%
    group_by(consumer_iso3c) %>%
    summarize(
      !!ssp126_var := sum(.data[[ssp126_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      !!ssp585_var := sum(.data[[ssp585_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    summarize(
      !!ssp126_var := round(sum(.data[[ssp126_var]]), 0),
      !!ssp585_var := round(sum(.data[[ssp585_var]]), 0)
    )

  # Check SSP126 production and consumption totals
  global_ssp126_check <-
    prod_global_totals[[ssp126_var]] ==
    cons_global_totals[[ssp126_var]]

  print(paste0(
    "Check: global ARTIS production and consumption totals for ",
    var, " modified by SSP126 are ",
    ifelse(global_ssp126_check, "identical", "not identical")
  ))

  if (global_ssp126_check) {
    print(paste0(
      "Global exposure ", var, " volume (SSP126): ",
      prod_global_totals[[ssp126_var]]
    ))
  }

  # Check SSP585 production and consumption totals
  global_ssp585_check <-
    prod_global_totals[[ssp585_var]] ==
    cons_global_totals[[ssp585_var]]

  print(paste0(
    "Check: global ARTIS production and consumption totals for ",
    var, " modified by SSP585 are ",
    ifelse(global_ssp585_check, "identical", "not identical")
  ))

  if (global_ssp585_check) {
    print(paste0(
      "Global exposure ", var, " volume (SSP585): ",
      prod_global_totals[[ssp585_var]]
    ))
  }
}




# Check by nation
prod_country_totals <- consumption_exp_mod %>%
  # key analysis distinction: group by consumer_iso3c
  group_by(producer_iso3c) %>%
  summarize(consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126 = sum(consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126, na.rm = TRUE),
            consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp585 = sum(consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp585, na.rm = TRUE))

cons_country_totals <- consumption_exp_mod %>%
  # key analysis distinction: group by consumer_iso3c
  group_by(consumer_iso3c) %>%
  summarize(consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126 = sum(consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126, na.rm = TRUE),
            consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp585 = sum(consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp585, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate for each country the proportion of their consumption that is
# consumed domestically

## Calculate total consumption weight
total_cons_country <- consumption_exp %>%
  group_by(consumer_iso3c) %>%
  summarize(total_cons = sum(live_weight_t))

## Calculate domestic consumption weight
dom_cons_country <- consumption_exp %>%
  filter(consumer_iso3c == producer_iso3c) %>%
  group_by(consumer_iso3c) %>%
  summarize(dom_cons = sum(live_weight_t))

## Calculate the proportion of consumption that is domestic by country
prop_domestic_cons <- left_join(dom_cons_country, total_cons_country, by = "consumer_iso3c") %>%
  group_by(consumer_iso3c) %>%
  summarize(prop_dom = dom_cons / total_cons)


  left_join(prod_country_totals, cons_country_totals, by = c("producer_iso3c" = "consumer_iso3c")) %>%
    left_join(prop_domestic_cons, by = c("producer_iso3c" = "consumer_iso3c")) %>%
    mutate(abs_diff = abs(consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126.x - consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126.y)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126.x, y = consumption_percap_live_kg_ssp126.y, color = prop_dom)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      x = "Production weight exposure",
      y = "Consumption weight exposure",
      color = "Proportion of consumption\nthat is domestic",
      title = "Nations' consumption and production exposure weights") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    # annotate("text", label = "1:1 line", x = 2e07, y = 1.7e07, angle = 41) +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

### Validation check: Ensure weights in ARTIS data at the start of analysis add up to at the end of analyis

We want to make sure that no data is dropped or added on, which would change the
end production and consumption weights. So here we compare here the global and
nationwide production and consumption weights, at data aqcuirement and after
analysis, ensuring values equal each other.

```{r compare before vs after analysis production & consumption weights}
# Step 1 - Disaggregate ARTIS consumption by EEZ of catch
consumption_before_analysis <- disagg_cons_by_eez()

# Read in ARTIS consumption joined-to-exposure data
consumption_after_analysis <- read_parquet("../output/consumption_catch_proj_gap_filled/3_species/consumption_total_portfolio_weighted_diagonal_gapfill.parquet")

# Calculate the global production weight with ARTIS consumption file before
# our analysis
before_analysis_total_prod <- consumption_before_analysis %>%
  group_by(producer_iso3c) %>%
  # Calculate the production weight of each country
  summarize(country_prod_weight = sum(live_weight_t), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Calculate the production weight globally
  summarize(global_prod_weight = sum(country_prod_weight)) %>%
  pull(global_prod_weight)

after_analysis_total_prod <- consumption_after_analysis %>%
  group_by(producer_iso3c) %>%
  # Calculate the production weight of each country
  summarize(country_prod_weight = sum(live_weight_t), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Calculate the production weight globally
  summarize(global_prod_weight = sum(country_prod_weight)) %>%
  pull(global_prod_weight)

# Validation check - production before equals the production after analysis
prod_b4_eq_prod_after_global <- before_analysis_total_prod == after_analysis_total_prod

# Print validation check result
print(paste0("Global ARTIS consumption file's production volumes at data acquirement equals production volumes at final analysis point: ",  ifelse(prod_b4_eq_prod_after_global, "Yes", "No")))


# Calculate the global consumption weight with ARTIS consumption file before
# our analysis
before_analysis_total_cons <- consumption_before_analysis %>%
  group_by(consumer_iso3c) %>%
  # Calculate the consumption weight of each country
  summarize(country_prod_weight = sum(live_weight_t), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Calculate the consumption weight globally
  summarize(global_prod_weight = sum(country_prod_weight)) %>%
  pull(global_prod_weight)

after_analysis_total_cons <- consumption_after_analysis %>%
  group_by(consumer_iso3c) %>%
  # Calculate the consumption weight of each country
  summarize(country_prod_weight = sum(live_weight_t), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Calculate the consumption weight globally
  summarize(global_prod_weight = sum(country_prod_weight)) %>%
  pull(global_prod_weight)

# Validation check - consumption before equals the consumption after analysis
cons_b4_eq_cons_after_global <- before_analysis_total_cons == after_analysis_total_cons

# Print validation check result
print(paste0("Global ARTIS consumption file's consumption volumes at data acquirement equals consumption volumes at final analysis point: ",  ifelse(prod_b4_eq_prod_after_global, "Yes", "No")))

# Double confirm that all production and consumption weights equal each other
everything_equals_globally <- all.equal(
  before_analysis_total_prod,
  after_analysis_total_prod,
  before_analysis_total_cons,
  after_analysis_total_cons
  )

# Print validation check result
```


### Species exposure data obtained from SAU looks similar to their paper's results

The exposure data we obtained From SAU measures the projected change in maximum
catch potential for a given species in an EEZ that they were caught in between
the present and the future. This data originates from the following paper:

Cheung, W. W. L., V. W. Y. Lam, J. L. Sarmiento, K. Kearney, R. Watson,
D. Zeller, and D. Pauly. 2010. Large-scale redistribution of maximum fisheries
catch potential in the global ocean under climate change. Global Change Biology,
16:24–35.
URL https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1365-2486.2009.01995.x.

We use this data in `01_Analysis.Rmd` to join the catch projection data to ARTIS
consumption. This validation check will examine the species catch projections
in our modified consumption dataset and verify that the figures look similar
to the paper. We also want to make sure that these projections in our data align
with other literature found across species projection papers. This is to ensure
that we did not mess up any of the data throughout our analysis.

```{r validate catch proj data similarities to accompanyingpaper}
## First calculate by EEZ their average latitutd  
# Read in EEZ boundaries
eez <- st_read("../data/validation_checks/World_EEZ_v12_20231025/eez_v12.shp") |>
  st_make_valid()

## Calculate for each EEZ their EEZ area and latitude
parts <- eez %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
    lat      = st_coordinates(st_centroid(geometry))[, "Y"]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

## Since a sovereign country may have multiple EEZ area polygons, we will
## calculate the average latitude weighted by their polygon areas
mean_lat_eez <- parts %>%
  group_by(ISO_SOV1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_lat_area_weighted = weighted.mean(lat, area_km2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_lat_area_weighted))

# Join mean latitudes to ARTIS production data

## filter ARTIS consumption to the data that is original to SAU data
## (i.e., no analysis done on our part to gap fill or average exposure to
## missing species estimates or reported taxa with lower resolution than
## true species)
cons_eez_sp <- consumption_exp %>%
  filter(gapfill_level == "No fill needed") %>%
  group_by(eez_iso3c, sciname_hs_modified, ssp126, ssp585) %>%
  summarize(live_weight_t = sum(live_weight_t), .groups = "drop")

# Join to mean latitude data
cons_eez_sp %>%
  left_join(mean_lat_eez, by = c("eez_iso3c" = "ISO_SOV1")) %>%
  group_by(eez_iso3c, mean_lat_area_weighted) %>%
  summarize(mean_change = mean(ssp126), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_lat_area_weighted) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_change, y = mean_lat_area_weighted)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(orientation = "y") +
  labs(x = "Change in maximum catch potential (%)",
       y = "Latitude (degree)") +
  theme_cowplot()

# Look into KWT species that are causing huge shifts in iso3c
consumption_exp %>%
  filter(gapfill_level == "No fill needed") %>%
  group_by(eez_iso3c, sciname_hs_modified, ssp126, ssp585) %>%
  summarize(live_weight_t = sum(live_weight_t), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(eez_iso3c == "KWT")


consumption_exp %>%
  filter(eez_iso3c == "KWT", gapfill_level == "No fill needed")
```

### Ensure the catch projection data remains the same before / after analysis

```{r}
mcp_sovereign <- preprocess_catch_projection_data(dir = dir)

mcp_sovereign %>%
  left_join(mean_lat_eez, by = c("eez_iso3c" = "ISO_SOV1")) %>%
  group_by(mean_lat_area_weighted) %>%
  summarize(mean_change = mean(ssp126, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_lat_area_weighted) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_change, y = mean_lat_area_weighted)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(orientation = "y") +
  labs(x = "Change in maximum catch potential (%)",
       y = "Latitude (degree)") +

mcp_sovereign %>%
  left_join(mean_lat_eez, by = c("eez_iso3c" = "ISO_SOV1")) %>%
  group_by(mean_lat_area_weighted) %>%
  summarize(mean_change = mean(ssp126, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% view()


mcp_sovereign %>%
  left_join(mean_lat_eez, by = c("eez_iso3c" = "ISO_SOV1")) %>%
  group_by(mean_lat_area_weighted)  %>% View()
```
